findings.text: follow-on: the module comment still states the superseded rule - 'the allowance falls back to headroom only for a block that states no window at all' - but after 9a25db160 a zero or negative observed_seconds also falls back, so the comment now contradicts the case added 250 lines below it.

follow-on: the docstring of test_a_stated_window_is_trusted_as_the_router_publishes_it still says 'Only a block stating no window at all is distrusted', which the new predicate narrows; it should name the positive-window rule the code now implements.

follow-on: _lane takes the allowance from _lane_worker_allowance (so it inherits the fix) but the picker's local-rule comparison at picker/__init__.py:88 and the published figure in run_time_profile.py local_lane_load read the admission worker_slots without the positive-window guard; if a router ever publishes slot figures beside a zero observed_seconds those consumers still act on them.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit - 9a25db160 changes dispatch.py (history_is_trusted requires observed > 0, comments and docstring updated) and tests/test_dispatch_counts_worker_slots.py (new nonpositive-window case plus the reflow of the 89-character monkeypatch line); bb934a5a3 adds the evidence fragment; both inside scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is met - a zero or below observed_seconds is read as no history (dispatch.py history_is_trusted gains `and observed > 0`), the new case fails at base and passes at head (independently reproduced here: base EXIT=1 with allowance 4 vs 2, head EXIT=0), and ruff format --check tests/test_dispatch_counts_worker_slots.py reports `1 file already formatted`, EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a router's zero-or-below observed_seconds read as no history, so dispatch falls through to the next slot figure exactly as it does for a missing window; reckon/crew/dispatch.py _lane_worker_allowance counts a published slot figure only when history_is_trusted, which now requires observed > 0.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; its baseline_suite (89690489f, 1 failed) and after_suite (9a25db160, 52 passed) reconcile with gate-base.log and gate-head.log, and the declared negative control gate-negative-control.log is red (1 failed / 51 passed, EXIT=1); the derived added-failure count is 0.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_dispatch_counts_worker_slots.py and the evidence fragment; the diff over 89690489f..bb934a5a3 changes exactly those three files and no file outside them.

justifications.durability: the negative control is a real guard - dropping `and observed > 0` reddens the new assertion (gate-negative-control.log, 1 failed / 51 passed, EXIT=1) - and the boundary is exercised around zero (0, 0.0, -1, and an existing test at a 320 s window of 57 slots); docked two because the same admission worker_slots figure still reaches reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:_lane and reckon/crew/run_time_profile.py local_lane_load without the positive-window guard this repair adds, so a router publishing slot figures beside a zero window would still steer local routing and be published by the profile.
justifications.evidence: gate-base.log (89690489f with the head test overlaid) reddens only test_a_nonpositive_window_is_read_as_no_history, gate-head.log (9a25db160) is 52 passed, and gate-negative-control.log reddens the same id with the `and observed > 0` clause removed; I re-derived the base failure and the head pass from git archive extractions and confirmed ruff format --check on the test file is clean, so the recorded result reconciles with every quote in the fragment.
justifications.fit: the fix reuses the existing history_is_trusted predicate and mechanism-named helpers and matches the module's comment idiom; docked three because the change left two stale comments in the test file it edited - the module note at tests/test_dispatch_counts_worker_slots.py:47-49 still says the allowance falls back 'only for a block that states no window at all', and the docstring at tests/test_dispatch_counts_worker_slots.py:247 still says 'Only a block stating no window at all is distrusted', both of which the new predicate narrows.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py _lane_worker_allowance makes history_is_trusted require observed > 0, so a zero or negative window skips every published slot figure and the allowance falls to the request headroom exactly as when the key is absent; the test asserts decision == _allowance(no_window) for observed in (0, 0.0, -1), which is the done-when's `exactly as it does for a missing value`; docked one because the plan's phrasing 'falls through to the next slot figure' is looser than the implemented and correct behaviour of falling through to headroom.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff over 89690489f..bb934a5a3 touches only reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_dispatch_counts_worker_slots.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the manifest's declared write paths, and the 89-character monkeypatch reflow is required by the done-when's second clause and was the finding the prior review raised.
